annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive: endpoints must treat the receipt of a TLS KeyUpdate message as a connection error of type 0x10a, equivalent to a fatal TLS alert of unexpected_message. There is no ambiguity in the required behavior, as the clause explicitly defines the consequence of receiving such a message. The reference to [tls-errors] is normative and does not introduce ambiguity in this context.
